title: Comet K-7
text: We see you on Cinder. We have a question you may be able to answer from there. Comet K-7 has the wrong tail. Its spectrum is refined isotope stock, not ice. We have tracked it since the night we landed, and every perihelion it passes within a day of Cinder. We think it is somebody's larder.
tags: act 2, survey, comet k-7, engram, radio
notes: STORY.md §13: Comet K-7 carries the Foundry's isotope stock; Engram tracks it.
